name: person-term-count
summary: Count how often chosen words are said: by one enrolled person (default), or by anyone (--without voice).

hardware.camera: only with --with lips: the same capture's video (a video file gives both)

references.name: person
references.label: the enrolled face (gamst recipe enroll person-action-count --kind person)

limits: overlapping voices are not separated by default: --with overlap scores each word on PixIT's separated per-speaker sources (pyannote, gated weights; slower than real time on a Mac CPU), --with target_voice mutes other voices before the words are read; --with hosted adds pyannoteAI identification as evidence beside each word (audio leaves the device, billed); --with lips (off by default) consults faces only for words whose voice score is in the ambiguous band, and only faces that pass the gate (size, turn, mouth in the picture, sharpness); it needs an enrolled face (--person) and the camera of the same capture; the speaker threshold must be set on your own audio; a phrase two people share gets one verdict; what another voice said is reported (term.other_voice) and never counted; --without voice counts every voice and says so (speaker: not_bound); --with tracks (opt-in; on the one measured clip Nemotron's slots mixed the person with others, docs/measurements/tracks-2026-11-26.md) decides each word by the streaming speaker slot active when it was said (audio.diarization, default Nemotron-3, low_latency mode) and that slot's accumulated sound against the voice, counts it at once as provisional, and settles it later as final or revoked; --with verification (opt-in, hosted: --allow-remote-asr) counts each word at once as provisional and settles it behind the live lane, in capture order, once that stretch is complete: a second hearing (gpt-live-transcribe with the words as keywords, Qwen3-ForcedAligner times) and pyannoteAI Precision-3 windows whose speakers are identified by the voice; revoked words say why (not_heard, no_speech, other_speaker, uncertain_overlap) and words only the second hearing heard are added as final (docs/catch-up-verification.md)
measured: --with verification: docs/measurements/catch-up-verification-2026-11-26.md; one 54 s clip of several people in a noisy shop (2026-11-26): docs/measurements/testbed-2026-11-26.md; --with lips changed no word (docs/measurements/av-speaker-2026-11-26.md); --with overlap was not reliably better (docs/measurements/overlap-2026-11-26.md); Qwen3-ASR was worse than Whisper turbo (docs/measurements/sota-asr-2026-11-26.md); --with tracks with Scribe v2 Realtime words: precision 0.58-0.83, recall 0.50-0.78 (docs/measurements/tracks-2026-11-26.md)
